image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a lionfish (Pterois) swimming against a dark, textured background. The fish displays characteristic red and white vertical stripes, large fan-like pectoral fins with elongated rays, and a dorsal fin with prominent spines. The head is visible with a distinct eye and mouth structure.
